title: Hierarchical Task Network Planning with LLM-Generated Heuristics
abstract: arXiv:2605.07707v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: HTN planning is a variation of classical planning where, instead of searching for a linear sequence of actions, an algorithm decomposes higher-level tasks using a method library until only executable actions remain. On the one hand, this allows one to introduce domain knowledge that can speed up the search for a solution through the method library. On the other hand, it creates challenges that go beyond those of classical state-space search. While recent research produced a number of heuristics and novel algorithms that speed up HTN planning, these heuristics are not yet as informative as those available in classical planning algorithms. We investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can generate effective search heuristics for HTN planning, extending the methodology of Corr\^ea et al. translated_title: 基于大语言模型生成启发式方法的分层任务网络规划
translated_abstract: HTN规划是经典规划的一种变体，其中算法不是搜索线性动作序列，而是利用方法库对更高层的任务进行分解，直到只剩下可执行的动作。一方面，这允许人们通过方法库引入领域知识，从而加速求解的搜索过程；另一方面，它也带来了超越经典状态空间搜索的挑战。尽管最近的研究提出了许多启发式方法和新颖算法来加速HTN规划，但这些启发式方法的信息量仍不及经典规划算法中已有的启发式方法。我们研究大语言模型（LLM）能否为HTN规划生成有效的搜索启发式方法，将Corrêa等人（arXiv:2503.18809）的方法论从经典规划扩展到分层规划。我们使用Pytrich规划器在七个标准的全序HTN基准领域上进行了评估……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本研究将基于大语言模型生成启发式方法的技术从经典规划扩展到分层任务网络（HTN）规划，探索LLM能否为HTN规划生成有效的搜索启发式，并在七个标准全序HTN基准领域上验证其效果。
en_tdlr: This work extends LLM-based heuristic generation from classical planning to hierarchical task network (HTN) planning, investigating whether LLMs can produce effective search heuristics for HTN planning across seven standard totally-ordered benchmark domains.
